title: Confluence attachment overwritten? Sealed files revert
subtitle: A colleague uploads over a sealed file and Sentinel Vault puts the sealed version back

steps.label: Open the page's Attachments list
steps.detail: Mihai does not own the sealed Regim caini.pdf

steps.label: Upload a new version of the file
steps.detail: Choose file: Regim caini.pdf, then Attach

steps.label: The upload lands
steps.detail: The row shows creator Mihai Perdum, 14:00

steps.label: Sentinel Vault reverts it
steps.detail: Undone: your change was reverted, the file is sealed by its owner

steps.label: Sealed version back on top
steps.detail: Creator Sentinel Vault: automatically reversed modifications

steps.label: Both users are told
steps.detail: A Seal Violation notification names the owner and the editor

steps.label: The violation comment
steps.detail: Your change was undone; your version is kept in the page history

callouts.text: Nothing lost: the edit stays in history
